sections.text: EWSR1 encodes an RNA-binding protein whose amino-terminal region can activate transcription.

sections.text: FLI1 encodes an ETS-domain transcription factor.

sections.text: The fusion links the EWSR1 amino-terminal transcriptional activation region to an ETS-family DNA-binding region, creating an oncogenic transcription factor that reprograms cell identity. EWSR1::FLI1 is a recognized Ewing sarcoma fusion.

audit_evidence.scope: ChIP-seq in Ewing cell lines and primary tumors; enhancer and transcriptional reprogramming.
